title: Longest prefix shared by a group of keys
insight: LeetCode 14 Longest Common Prefix: shrink a candidate prefix against every key, stopping at the first differing byte
prompt: We need SharedPrefix in prefix.go working for the config admin UI; README.md is the spec, including how empty and single-key groups behave. Keep the config package name and the exported signature untouched, use only the standard library, and check that `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` come back clean.
